steps.title: Make the crust
steps.body: Mix together **1¾ cups graham cracker crumbs**, **3 Tbsp sugar** and **1 cube butter**, melted. Press into a 10×12 pan.

steps.title: Add the toppings
steps.body: Top with **6 oz chocolate chips**, **3½ oz flaked coconut** and **1 cup chopped walnuts**.

steps.title: Add the milk
steps.body: Pour **1 can sweetened condensed milk** over the nuts, coconut and chips.

steps.title: Bake
steps.body: Bake at 350°F for 25 minutes until light brown.
